$description: Doefin brand 0.2.0. Generated by scripts/build.py from the repository sources. Do not edit by hand.

ink.$description: Doefin ink. The brand's dark ground, and the text colour on light grounds. The same in both themes: use it for logo plates, social cards and title slides that are always dark.

blue.$description: Doefin Blue, the one accent. Use it for the single thing to look at: a large number, a chart's main line, one block of colour. As text, only at 24px and up (or bold 19px and up). White on blue is 4.1:1, so the same size rule applies. Buttons use `action`; links use `link`.

white.$description: The wordmark and text on `ink` and `blue` plates.

logo.$description: The wordmark's colour on `bg`: white in dark, ink in light. Use it when the logo sits on the page ground rather than on a plate.

bg.$description: Page ground. `ink` in dark; a cool off-white in light.

surface.$description: Cards, panels and chart frames on `bg`. Edge them with `line`, not a shadow.

surface-alt.$description: Summary panels, table header rows, quote and code blocks.

selected.$description: Selected tab, active row, current step. Put `text` on it. In dark, `text-muted` is only 4.4:1 here, so do not use it on `selected`.

line.$description: Hairlines: dividers, panel edges, chart gridlines. Decorative only, so it never carries meaning on its own.

line-strong.$description: Borders people must see: inputs, checkboxes, outline buttons. 3.1:1 or more on `bg`, `surface` and `surface-alt` in both themes.

text.$description: Headings and body copy on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-alt` and `selected`. 9.5:1 or more in both themes.

text-muted.$description: Labels, dates, captions and source lines on `bg`, `surface` and `surface-alt` (5.8:1 or more). One grey replaces the old pair, #838EA7 and #99A2B5: the lighter one keeps more contrast on every dark panel.

link.$description: Text links and inline actions on `bg`, `surface` and `surface-alt` (4.7:1 or more).

action.$description: Fill of the primary button, with `on-action` text (5.4:1). One primary button per view.

action-hover.$description: Primary button on hover. White text on it is 4.9:1.

focus.$description: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid with a 2px gap. 4.3:1 or more on every ground in both themes.

up.$description: Gains only: a position or a price that went up. Always with a + sign or an up arrow. Text on `bg`, `surface` and `surface-alt` (4.7:1 or more).

down.$description: Losses and errors only. Always with a minus sign, a down arrow or an error message. Text on `bg` and `surface` (4.6:1 or more). Never decoration: no orange eyebrows or icons.

caution.$description: Warnings and the Illustrative badge. Use it as a fill with `on-caution` text (10.3:1).

chart-1.$description: The main series in a chart: our data, our forecast. With `chart-2` it passes the colour-blind and contrast checks on `bg` and `surface` in both themes.

chart-2.$description: One comparison series, used only when a second series needs its own colour. Label both series on the chart.

chart-context.$description: Everything else in a chart: other sources, history, benchmarks. Charts sit on `surface`, where this is 3:1 or more.

chart-band.$description: The range around a forecast. State the same range in numbers in the caption.

space-2.$description: Inside badges and chips; between a figure and its unit.

space-3.$description: Between a label and its value.

space-4.$description: The side gutter on phones; card padding on phones.

space-6.$description: Card padding; the gap between cards.

space-12.$description: Between sections on phones; slide margins.

space-24.$description: Above and below a page hero.

radius-header.$description: Large header plates and hero cards.

mono.$description: Wallet and contract addresses, transaction hashes. Never for figures.

display.$description: Title slides, social cards and the one big statement on a page. Not in the app.

body-lg.$description: Anything longer than a paragraph: articles, research, docs. Keep lines under `measure`.

body.$description: Interface text in the app and on the website.

small.$description: Captions, source lines, footnotes and the disclaimer, in `text-muted`.

label.$description: Eyebrows, column heads and badge text. Always set in capitals.

figure-xl.$description: The one number on a social card or a slide.

figure.$description: Key figures on pages and in emails.
